'''Kea Moll's father''' was a native of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Annoo]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he lived on a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] with his partner, [[Demma Moll]], and their daughter, [[Kea Moll|Kea]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on a mission for the [[Annoo resistance|local resistance cell]] sometime before [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].
